title: Accounts
about: One place to connect everything: Facebook, Instagram, your ad accounts, your catalog, WhatsApp and TikTok. Your AI agents use them to answer messages and comments, and for your ads.
help: “Continue with Facebook” opens Facebook in a new tab. Log in, tick everything (Pages, Instagram, ad accounts, catalog, pixels) and accept: Pilotix does the rest and the account turns green. Nothing is pasted anywhere else. “Test” tells you, part by part, what works and where the problem is. The keys stay on Pilotix’s server, never in a page.
helpTwo: Meta has two buttons; each opens Facebook in a new tab. “Facebook and Instagram”: tick only this boutique’s Page and its Instagram. “Meta ads”: tick your ad accounts, your catalog and your pixels. Accept: Pilotix does the rest and the account turns green. “Test” tells you, part by part, what works and where the problem is. The keys stay on Pilotix’s server, never in a page.

here.title: Used in “{{name}}”
here.noPage: No Page: link a Facebook account.

scopeHereHint: Its Page and ad accounts work here at once.
scopeAllHint: Each boutique then picks its Page in one click. A Page answers for one boutique only.
scopeAllHintTwo: For the ads and TikTok: every boutique counts them. A Facebook Page is linked from each boutique.

meta.name: Facebook, Instagram and ads
meta.what: One button connects all of Meta at once.
meta.allow: In Facebook’s window, tick everything: your Pages, your Instagram accounts, your ad accounts, your catalog and your pixels. Then accept everything. What is not ticked does not work in Pilotix.
meta.notReady: Soon: Pilotix is getting the Facebook link ready.

tiktok.name: TikTok
tiktok.what: Your TikTok ad accounts: your Catalog lists can go there, and their numbers come to Ads soon.
tiktok.notReady: Soon: Pilotix is getting the TikTok link ready.

metaContent.name: Facebook and Instagram
metaContent.what: This boutique’s Page and its Instagram: messages, comments, posts.
metaContent.allow: In Facebook’s window, tick only this boutique’s Page and its Instagram account, then accept everything. Pilotix keeps one Page per boutique.
metaContent.notReady: Soon: Pilotix is getting the Facebook link ready.
metaContent.hereOnly: Always for this boutique: a Page is linked to one boutique only.

metaAds.name: Meta ads
metaAds.what: Your ad accounts, your catalog, your pixels and your lead forms.
metaAds.allow: In Facebook’s window, tick your ad accounts, your catalog, your pixels and your Page (ads go out in its name), then accept everything. The same Facebook account or another one.
metaAds.notReady: Soon: Pilotix is getting the ads link ready.
metaAds.viaFirst: The “Continue with Facebook” button connects your ads too: tick your ad accounts in it.

waitingHelp: Finish in the {{name}} tab that opened: log in, tick everything and accept.
confirmHelp: In the {{name}} tab, press « Oui, c’est ma boutique » (yes, this is my shop) to link this account.
waitingPreview: Preview: the login is simulated and takes two seconds.
blocked: Your browser blocked the new tab. Open it with the button.
closed: The tab was closed before the end. Start again whenever you want.
none: No account linked yet. Start with Facebook: that is where your customers write to you.
relinkHint: Reconnect this account and tick everything: a new key, Pages, Instagram and ad accounts up to date.
relinkNow: Facebook no longer accepts this account: link it again.

igKey.ok: Instagram answers: with your Facebook account’s key. Dellal answers all your customers of @{{username}}.
igKey.fixed: Instagram answers: Pilotix just switched to your Facebook account’s key. Dellal now answers all your customers of @{{username}}.
igKey.old: Instagram answers: with an old key of @{{username}}, connected before in Pilot Message. It works: nothing to do.
igKey.oldBad: Instagram answers: the old key no longer works, and your Facebook account’s key does not have @{{username}}’s inbox. Click “Link again”, tick the Instagram account and accept everything.

igKey.oldReady: Instagram answers: with an old key of @{{username}}, connected before in Pilot Message. It works. Your Facebook account’s key can answer too: to keep one single connection, remove the old one in “Old connections”, at the top of the page.

adsState.s3: Ad account “{{name}}”: a payment failed. Its ads are stopped. Pay it in Meta › Billing.

adsState.s9: Ad account “{{name}}”: a payment is late. Meta still leaves some time: pay it quickly.

adsOld.relink: Ads work with an old key pasted in Settings › Meta Ads (account “{{name}}”). To put everything here: click “Link again” and tick your ad account.
adsOld.switchBad: Ads: the old pasted key no longer works (account {{name}}). Turn on “Count them” above: this Facebook account takes its place.

adsRight.none: Facebook gave this key no right on ads. Click “Link again” and look closely at Facebook’s window: your ad account must be listed there, and ticked. If it is not listed, the block is at Meta, not in Pilotix: the ad account must be in the business account (portfolio) you choose, and you must be its admin.

ask.instagram: Remove this old Instagram key? Your Facebook account’s key answers instead.
